name: Anime Festival Wichita
blurb: A three-day anime convention in Wichita, Kansas with voice actors, cosplay contests, karaoke and gaming.
notes: The homepage still reads 'Anime Festival Wichita Will Return JUNE 19, 20 & 21 2026' and its guest list is still labeled 'Our 2025 Guests' - that 2026 edition (June 19-21, 2026) already ran before this window starts (2026-10-05) and the site has not been updated with 2027 dates yet. A web search likewise found no confirmed 2027 dates, so editions is left empty.
